brief:
A football team representing Palestine competed internationally in 1934 despite lacking Arab Palestinian players, Al Jazeera English reported. The squad's composition reflected the political and social divisions of the mandate period, with official representations of Palestinian identity excluding the majority Arab population from participation in organized sport.

The team's makeup revealed how institutional structures in Palestine under the British mandate shaped athletic representation and national identity during the interwar years.
dek: The forgotten story of the football team that played as Palestine in 1934 — without Arab Palestinian players.
title: Palestine's 1934 Football Team Played Without Arab Palestinian Players
